INSERT INTO canonical_asset_registry (
    asset_id,
    sha256, 
    avatar,
    asset_type,
    scene,
    version,
    workflow,
    model,
    seed,
    bucket,
    object_path,
    original_filename,
    mime_type,
    file_size,
    extension,
    prompt,
    negative_prompt,
    sampler,
    steps,
    cfg,
    tags,
    metadata
)
VALUES (
    '{{ $('Create image metadata').first().json.assetId }}',
    '{{ $('Create image metadata').first().json.sha256 }}',
    '{{ $('Create image metadata').first().json.avatar }}',
    '{{ $('Create image metadata').first().json.assetType }}',
    '{{ $('Create image metadata').first().json.scene }}',
    {{ $('Create image metadata').first().json.version }},
    '{{ $('Create image metadata').first().json.workflow }}',
    '{{ $('Create image metadata').first().json.model }}',
    {{ $('Create image metadata').first().json.seed }},
    '{{ $('Create image metadata').first().json.storage.bucket }}',
    '{{ $('Create image metadata').first().json.storage.path }}{{ $('Create image metadata').first().json.file.name }}',
    '{{ $('Create image metadata').first().json.file.name }}',
    '{{ $('Create image metadata').first().json.file.mimeType }}',
    {{ $('Create image metadata').first().json.file.size }},
    '{{ $('Create image metadata').first().json.file.extension }}',
    '{{ $('Create image metadata').first().json.generation.prompt }}',
    '{{ $('Create image metadata').first().json.generation.negativePrompt }}',
    '{{ $('Create image metadata').first().json.generation.sampler }}',
    NULL,
    NULL,
    '{{ JSON.stringify($('Create image metadata').first().json.tags) }}'::jsonb,
    '{{ JSON.stringify($('Create image metadata').first().json) }}'::jsonb
)

ON CONFLICT (object_path)
DO NOTHING;
